ghost: A ghost is the spirit or soul of a man.
A ghost is the soul of a dead person that shows up after death.
The house was haunted by the ghost of the little boy who used to live here.
A ghost is any faint thing that looks like a shadow.
Tom was scared of a ghost.
ghoul: A ghoul is like a ghost.
Behind the tree, you can see a ghoul.
ghostlike: If something or someone is ghostlike, they look like a ghost; they look invisible.
ghana: Ghana is a country in Africa. Its full name is The Republic of Ghana.
ghetto: A ghetto is a part of a city lived by poor people, especially a slum area.
was a poor child from the ghetto areas around St. Louis.
ghastly: Something that is ghastly is gross and scary.
ghanaian: If something is Ghanaian, it is of or about Ghana.
If someone is Ghanaian, they are a citizen of Ghana.
A Ghanaian is an citizen of Ghana.
ghostly: If something is ghostly, it looks or feels like a ghost or reminds people of ghosts.
A ghostly figure appeared in the old house.
If something is ghostly, it is faint, pale, or hard to see.
A ghostly light shone through the fog.
ghosthunter: A ghosthunter is someone who tries to find ghosts.
